author: kesudh
method: Rust warm-start large-neighborhood search: exact per-net SPT reroute with equal-delay tie exploration, group rip-up with negotiated-congestion rounds (PathFinder-style history/present costs), bounded threshold acceptance; every accepted state re-verified by the repository checker.

upstream_credit.author: Taz33m
upstream_credit.note: Warm starts are PR#3's routes at head 4e21227, the version that led all six tier aggregates before this refinement.

selection: Lowest checker-recomputed delay across the warm start and every refinement run; the warm-start route is retained verbatim (identical sha256) on cases with no strict win.
runtime: Per-case wall seconds of the incremental refinement only; excludes warm-start generation.
